name: @cargo-ai/cli
stderr:
Usage: cargo-ai [options] [command]

Cargo API CLI

Options:
  -V, --version               output the version number
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  start|onboard [options]     Open a coding agent, run the guided demo, or set
                              up a project — signing you in first if needed
  ask [options] [message...]  Chat in the palette tree. Defaults to Claude Code
                              on this machine; optional --agent-uuid attaches
                              that agent to the same local session.
  login [options]             Sign in to Cargo with an emailed code (--email),
                              via browser (--oauth), or with an existing API
                              token (--token)
  logout [options]            Sign out: revoke the saved credential and remove
                              it locally
  whoami                      Show current user and workspace
  version [options]           Print the installed CLI version, or check npm for
                              a newer release with --check
  doctor                      Diagnose the CLI setup: version vs latest and the
                              skills-bundle pin, credentials, and API
                              reachability
  book-demo [options]         Open the calendar to book a Cargo demo with sales
  observability               Alerts and alert events
  orchestration               Workflows, plays, runs, batches, tools, templates
  workspaceManagement         Workspaces, users, tokens, environment variables,
                              roles, folders, reports, sessions
  storage                     Datasets, models, relationships, runs, records
  content                     Workspace files and libraries
  connection                  Connectors and integrations
  context                     Context repository and runtime sandbox operations
  billing                     Usage and subscription
  segmentation                Segments and changes
  revenue-organization        Allocations, capacities, members, territories
  expression                  Recipes and expression evaluation
  system-of-record            System of record, client, logs
  user-management             Current user (no workspace context)
  ai                          AI templates, agents, releases, chats, MCP
  hosting                     Cargo Hosting: apps (Vite SPAs), workers (edge
                              HTTP handlers), and deployments
  mailboxManagement           Owned sending mailboxes, threads, events,
                              suppressions, and pricing
  mcp [options]               Run a local MCP server that bridges to a Cargo
                              MCP server over stdio
  project|cdk                 Define this workspace in a repo and deploy it
                              (init/plan/deploy)
  help [command]              display help for command

Agent skills:
  Teach your coding agent this CLI — skills covering sourcing, enrichment,
  orchestration, storage, connectors, workspace-as-code (CDK), diagnostics and alerts.
    Any agent (skills.sh):  npx skills add getcargohq/cargo-skills
    Claude Code:            /plugin marketplace add getcargohq/cargo-skills
    Codex:                  codex plugin marketplace add getcargohq/cargo-skills
    Source:                 https://github.com/getcargohq/cargo-skills
  Standalone one-job GTM skills (find leads, work emails, TAM, signals):
    Any agent (skills.sh):  npx skills add getcargohq/gtm-skills

Authentication:
  Emailed code:       cargo-ai login --email you@company.com  (no browser; signs you up on first use)
  Browser sign-in:    cargo-ai login --oauth
  With API token:     cargo-ai login --token <your-token>
  Use env variables:  CARGO_API_TOKEN, CARGO_WORKSPACE_UUID, CARGO_BASE_URL
  Check status:       cargo-ai whoami

Ask:
  cargo-ai ask "…"          Ask in the palette tree, with a first message
  cargo-ai ask --continue   Continue the last chat
  cargo-ai ask --print "…"  One turn, JSON on stdout
  cargo-ai --chat           Open
